setting: 2回目のデート。Miaは先に店に着いて、窓際の席でLeoを待っていた。Leoが着いて席に座った直後。
lyrics:
[Intro]
(I keep trying to impress you)
(I don't know what I got myself into with you)

[Verse 1]
You said you like window shopping, try before you buy
You got me losing sleep, I've got no appetite
We keep trying to talk it out, but all the words don't count
When you look at me there's nervous energy

[Pre-Chorus]
Why did I buy this dress?
I've got my hair done up
You said you liked me in red so I wore just a touch
Now you've got something that seems to mess me up
I think I care too much
Why do I care so much now?

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into

[Verse 2]
Pull up at the restaurant, you say it's been too long
Now I'm kinda stressed, I think I'm overdressed
But I'd love it if you noticed all the effort that I've focussed on tonight
(And every other night)

[Pre-Chorus]
I know I look my best
I've got my hair done up
You said you liked me in red
So I wore just a touch

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you

[Bridge]
Na-na-na-na-na-na
Na-na-na-na-na-na
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know
I don't know who I am with you
Na-na-na-na-na-na
Na-na-na-na-na-na
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know
I don't know who I am with you

[Chorus]
I keep trying to impress you
I don't know why that is, but I have to
You'd never know that I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you
You keep coming back around
I'm nervous just to let you down
I don't know who I am when I'm with you
'Cause I keep trying to impress you
I don't know what I got myself into with you

[Outro]
(I keep trying to impress you)
(I don't know what I got myself in—)

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I keep trying to act normal, but I'm kinda terrible at it tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: I keep trying to act normal, but I'm kinda terrible at it tonight.

conversation.japanese: 普通にしてようとしてるんだけど、今日はちょっとうまくできてない。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You looked calm when I walked in.
sentences.displayHtml: You looked calm when I walked in.

conversation.japanese: うまくできてないって？全然そう見えなかったよ。入ってきたとき、落ち着いて見えた。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I saw you pull up at the restaurant, and I almost checked my hair again.
sentences.displayHtml: I saw you pull up at the restaurant, and I almost checked my hair again.

conversation.japanese: 落ち着いてなかったよ。Leoが店に着いたのを見て、また髪を確認しそうになった。

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.japanese: それ、ちょっとかわいいけど。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I don't know what it is, but you got me caring about tiny things that usually don't count.
sentences.displayHtml: I don't know what it is, but you got me caring about tiny things that usually don't count.

conversation.japanese: 何なのかわからないけど、Leoといると、普段なら気にしない小さなことまで大事に思えちゃう。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I'm not judging every little thing you do.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm not judging every little thing you do.

conversation.japanese: 試験じゃないよ、Mia。ひとつひとつ採点してるわけじゃない。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I just had no appetite all day because I kept thinking about tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: I just had no appetite all day because I kept thinking about tonight.

conversation.japanese: わかってる。今日のことを考えすぎて、一日中食欲がなかった。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Can we at least try before you decide the night is going badly?
sentences.displayHtml: Can we at least try before you decide the night is going badly?

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、もっと気楽にしよう。今夜はダメだって決めつける前に、まず普通に過ごしてみない？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I'm nervous just to say this, but I really wanted tonight to go well.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm nervous just to say this, but I really wanted tonight to go well.

conversation.japanese: やってみる。これを言うだけでも緊張するけど、今日は本当にうまくいってほしかった。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Honestly, I'd love it if you stopped trying to impress me and just talked to me.
sentences.displayHtml: Honestly, I'd love it if you stopped trying to impress me and just talked to me.

conversation.japanese: 言ってくれてうれしいよ。正直、よく見せようとしなくていいから、ただ普通に話してくれたらうれしい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Then I'll start by actually looking at the menu.
sentences.displayHtml: Then I'll start by actually looking at the menu.

conversation.japanese: わかった。じゃあまず、ちゃんとメニューを見るところから始める。

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.japanese: うん。僕もそうする。焦らなくていい。
